line_card_notes.8: Split for Simutrans, where 8 and 8S are separate lines. 8S needs 7 trams: 28 min out, 4 min layover at Novolíšeňská, 29 min back and 2 min at Bohunice make a 63-min round trip, and at every 10 min that is 7 trams. 8 needs 16 (73-min round trip, two departures every 10 min), and the 24th tram is marked not needed. The records do not say which kurz ran the short trips, so 8S takes the five peak-only kurzy whose car changed between the morning and the afternoon (20, 26, 32, 42, 48) plus 44 and 46.

designed.why: 5S needs 5 trams (61-min round trip at every 10 min) and 4 were logged. 1088 (Pragoimex VarioLF2R.E) is the only car from the 5S history that was free on Fri 25 Sep: it ran 5S kurz 25 on Thu 24 Sep and kurz 27 on Thu 17 Sep, is active in the register, and appears on no line on 25 Sep. The four logged 5S trams already cover both 5S types (Škoda 03T6, VarioLF2R.E); no other free history car exists (line 5 records 16–24 Sep).

texts.eyebrow: Brno · tramvaje · DPMB · od úterý 29. 9. 2026 · odpolední špička
texts.lede: The Brno tram network after the Kníničská closure: the weekday timetable in force from Tue 29 Sep 2026, with the fleet of the Friday 25 Sep afternoon peak adjusted to it. The first table lists exactly what to change in the Simutrans model built from the 27 Sep sheet; everything below is the complete new state.
texts.network_intro: The weekday timetable in force from Tue 29 Sep (IDS JMK GTFS exported 25 Sep; every weekday from 29 Sep to at least 6 Oct is identical, service day used: Fri 2 Oct).
texts.termini_intro: The termini from the Brno Termini sheet in their state from 29 Sep: track count and layout, and the lines leaving each one between 16:00 and 16:59. From 29 Sep line 10 is back on the Komín loop (boarding stop Komín, smyčka); Sochorova is no longer a terminus.
texts.schedule_extra: Stub termini (Mifkova, Nemocnice Bohunice) keep the real minute.
texts.schedule_exact: Each pattern is fitted to the afternoon peak core and reproduces the real departures exactly over the span shown. Line 12 uses a 14-min interval; 14 does not divide 1440, so the fork restarts the pattern at midnight, which does not affect the day.
texts.method_state:
From 29 Sep. The IDS JMK feed switches to a new tram timetable on Tue 29 Sep: line 10 back to Komín, lines 1, 3 and 12 retimed, 2, 7 and 9 shifted by a minute; lines 4, 5, 6 and 8 are unchanged. Trams per line come from the timetable cycle at 16:00 on Fri 2 Oct compared with Fri 25 Sep (a tram followed through its round trip with at least 3 min layover); the vehicles are still the ones recorded on Fri 25 Sep. Where a line logged more trams than its new need (line 3: 16 against 12), the surplus is marked not needed (user rule, 29 Sep); line 12 is covered by its own 14 logged trams, so the earlier suggestion to move three trams off line 3 is dropped.

Compared with the closure sheet. This sheet is the state from 29 Sep; the Brno Tram Peak Fleet sheet keeps the closure state of 27 Sep.

changes_why.1: Timetable shifted after the double track on Kníničská is back.
changes_why.2: 1-min shift of the Stará osada departures.
changes_why.3: New headway: every 6–7 min instead of every 5.
changes_why.10: Western terminus moves from Sochorova back to the Komín loop.
changes_why.12: New headway: a 5, 5, 4 min cycle, now exact.

texts.changes_route: Route change. Line 10: replace the Sochorova terminus with the Komín loop (boarding Komín, smyčka; alighting Vozovna Komín), one stop further west.
texts.removed_intro: Trams needed by the timetable cycle at 16:00 (a tram followed through its round trip, at least 3 min layover at each end): line 3 needs 12 instead of 15, line 12 needs 14 instead of 12, and every other line, line 10 included, needs the same as before. Keeping the slack DPMB ran on Fri 25 Sep, line 3 goes from 19 to 16 trams and line 12 from 14 to 16. So two of line 3’s trams move to line 12 (one Pisárky set for an odd kurz, one Medlánky car for an even kurz) and one goes to the depot reserve. DPMB’s real choice of kurzy is not known until the first vypravenost after 29 Sep; these are suggestions.
texts.method_extra: Cross-check. The kurz counts per line (24, 15, 19, 16, 13, 17, 9, 24, 17, 5, 14) on Fri 25 Sep equal the afternoon totals from the 8–10 Sep records in the Termini sheet. They also fit the GTFS, which has 22, 11, 14, 14, 8, 14, 6, 20, 13, 3 and 10 trips on the move at 16:00; the remaining trams are standing at termini.
